topic.angle: Why the headline interest rate is not the whole story

body.claim: A 5% interest rate in a year with 2% price rises earns about 3% in real terms.
body.why: The real interest rate is what a saver or lender receives after allowing for inflation. It is roughly the nominal rate minus the inflation rate, a link known as the Fisher equation. Prices are rising, so each dollar you get back buys a little less than it did.

probes.question: You earn 5% interest in a year when prices rise 2%. About what is your real interest rate?
True or false: the real interest rate is the rate you receive after allowing for inflation.
